content: Shall be able to standardize components Type: valid Description: STDT shall be able to express standardization of components, even if AUTOSAR does not standardize components. This requirement covers a set of individual components. No compatibility rules shall hardwired in STDT. Support is provided by the fact that it only allows to specify SwComponentType as eligible for blueprinting. Rationale: This allows to leverage AUTOSAR standardization principles inside a company.
